newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end higher across the board.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end higher across the board.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed higher across the board on Friday on technical buying from local investors, traders said.
Prices ranged from 110 yen to 230 yen per tonne higher, with the benchmark May 1998 contract closing 110 yen up at 14,260 yen. The day's estimated trade volume was 45,585 lots.
Technical buying from local investors supported all contracts throughout the day, traders said. They added that stronger CBOT corn prices overnight partly encouraged investors.
The spot July corn contract on the CBOT Project A overnight trading system stood at $2.71-1/2 per bushel at 0815 GMT, up from $2.69-1/4 at Thursday's close.
Spot July CBOT soybean futures were trading at $8.83 a bushel at 0815 GMT, up from $8.69-1/2 at Thursday's close.
